button-border-radius.description: No matching --ct-... token in civictheme.variables.css for this value: upstream's back-to-top.css resolves it at SCSS-compile-time from ct-particle(12) (spacing.base(8px) * 12) rather than exposing it as its own CSS custom property. Literal taken directly from the compiled back-to-top.css border-radius. Applied here to override ct-button's own --ct-button-border-radius (0.25rem default) so the composed button renders fully round, matching upstream's pill-shaped back-to-top button.
